bug_fix_details.root_cause: In /api/jobs/greenhouse/search streaming endpoint, lines 2457-2459 were unconditionally overwriting job['description'] with an auto-generated summary and setting job['full_description'] to empty string
bug_fix_details.fix_applied: Changed code to only set description if not already present, and populate full_description from the existing description
bug_fix_details.before: job['description'] = f'{title} position at {company} in {location}'; job['full_description'] = ''
bug_fix_details.after: if not job.get('description'): job['description'] = summary; job['full_description'] = job.get('description', '')
